Lena C.: customer says API call intended to apply store credit ended up charging card instead. urgent, customer lost $120 :cry:
Samir N.: sorry to hear that — can you paste the original request and any error/response you saw?
Lena C.: here is the call from the storefront (redacted):
```json
POST /v1/toolcall
{
  "user_id": "acct_123",
  "tool": "apply_credit",
  "args": { "amount_cents": 12000, "reason": "order refund" }
}
```
Lena C.: but our logs show it routed to `upsert_credit` which creates a ledger entry that triggered a capture flow on our payments system.
Jordan (eng): that sounds like an alias collision — our tool resolver matches by fuzzy name sometimes. do you have the server request body from the upstream router?
Lena C.: pasted server side payload (from proxy):
```json
{"user_id":"acct_123","invoker":"storefront","tool":"credit","args":{"amount":120.00}}
```
Samir N.: ah — the router receives `tool: "credit"` and picks the first matching handler, which currently is `upsert_credit` (legacy).
Alyssa (ops): logs from the runtime at 2024-07-21T14:34:56Z:
```
INFO resolver: received request tool_hint=credit, candidate_handlers=[apply_credit, upsert_credit, apply_store_credit]
INFO resolver: matched handler=upsert_credit (score=0.87)
INFO invoker: invoking upsert_credit handler id=hdl_988
ERROR payments: triggered capture on ledger entry id=led_7a9
```
Jordan (eng): repro steps: set tool_hint to ambiguous short name and you'll hit legacy `upsert_credit`. Fixes: 1) prefer exact match longer name, 2) require explicit `tool` field to be full name, or 3) add a disambiguation API error when multiple handlers score > threshold.
Samir N.: customers call code often comes from mobile/web clients where we collapse names to short alias `credit`. We need backward compatibility but safety-first.
Lena C.: customer wants refund now — can ops reverse the ledger and issue store credit?
Alyssa (ops): I can open a reversals ticket but need ledger id and payment id. Lena share tx ids from the server logs.
Lena C.: tx ids: payment_tx=pay_9f3, ledger=led_7a9.
Alyssa (ops): queued reversal request — ETA 45m. will confirm when done.
Jordan (eng): in parallel I'll push a hotfix to the resolver. Proposed quick fix in pseudocode:
```
// prefer exact matches, fallback to fuzzy only if single candidate
candidates = find_handlers(tool_hint)
if exact = candidates.filter(name == tool_hint || full_name == tool_hint):
  chosen = exact[0]
else if candidates.length == 1:
  chosen = candidates[0]
else:
  return error(400, "ambiguous tool hint: please provide fully-qualified tool name")
```
Jordan (eng): planning a patch to reject ambiguous short hints with 400. will deploy to staging and run replay for last 6h to find other occurrences.
Samir N.: also add logging metric `runtime.tool_ambiguity` to alert when ambiguous hits > 0.
